comment: Two humans, one per side, on the amphibious showcase (scenarios/pelagic_counterlanding.lua). The scenario declares exactly two sides on teams 0 and 1, so there are no filler null-AI slots to materialise gap teams and no NPC team that would collide with Gaia's index. A copy of this file must also live in client/public/ — that, not manifests/, is what ?direct= fetches. NOTE: the ?direct= path does NOT validate the scenario id against the lobby's discovery snapshot, so a typo here boots a room with no scenario loaded rather than failing; check the game log for '[game_scenario] loaded' before believing a run.
name: dev:pelagic-counterlanding
